cards.text: The LORD of Hosts speaks through Malachi (Malachi 1:1), and this word is for the priests. He starts with two pictures everybody knows: a son and his father, a servant and his master. I'm nervous already, and I'm not even a priest.

cards.question: The LORD says a son gives his father something, and a servant gives his master the same. What is it?

cards.text: Then He asks the priests: if He is a father, where is His honor? And if He is a master, where is their fear of Him?
He calls them priests who despise His name, and they ask, "How have we despised Your name?" His answer goes straight to His altar, where the offerings are supposed to be holy (Leviticus 22:2).

cards.question: The LORD answers the priests: they've despised His name by presenting ___ food on His altar.

cards.text: So they ask AGAIN: "How have we defiled You?" These men are like the dead batteries I shared that junk drawer with, still swearing they've got plenty of charge left.

cards.question: The LORD says the priests have been calling the table of the LORD contemptible.

cards.text: Then the LORD gets specific: blind animals for sacrifice, lame ones, sick ones. And He suggests a little experiment.

cards.question: The LORD tells the priests to try offering those blind, lame and sick animals to their governor.

cards.text: Then the LORD asks: with this coming from their hands, will God show them favor? And He says He wishes one of them would just shut the temple doors.

cards.question: The LORD wants those temple doors shut, so the priests would no longer kindle ___ fires on His altar.
The LORD says He will still accept offerings from these priests' hands.

cards.text: Then the LORD looks far beyond this temple, all the way from where the sun rises to where it sets.

cards.question: The LORD says His name will be great among the ___, and pure offerings will be presented in His name in every place.

cards.text: But these priests call His table defiled and its food contemptible, and they say, "Oh, what a nuisance!" That's the voice people use when the alarm goes off on a Monday, and they're using it about the table of the LORD.

cards.question: How do the priests treat the LORD's table?

answers.text: They turn up their nose at it
They bow down low before it

cards.question: Along with lame and sick animals, the priests are also bringing offerings that are stolen.

cards.text: Then the LORD calls out a deceiver. This man has an acceptable male in his flock, and he vows to give it.

cards.question: The deceiver has an acceptable male in his flock and vows to give it. What does he sacrifice to the Lord instead?
The LORD calls the deceiver who breaks his vow cursed and says He is a great ___, whose name is to be feared.

cards.text: Now the LORD has a decree just for the priests. If they don't listen and don't take it to heart to honor His name, He will send a curse among them.

cards.question: The LORD says He will send a curse among the priests, and He will even curse their ___.
The LORD says He has already begun to curse them.

cards.text: Then the LORD says He'll rebuke their descendants and spread dung on their faces, the waste from their feasts. And they'll be carried off with it.
He says this commandment is so His covenant with Levi may continue, a covenant of life and peace. Levi is the name the priests' tribe carries (Deuteronomy 33:8-10).

cards.question: The LORD's covenant with Levi called for reverence. How did Levi respond?

answers.text: He stood in awe of His name
He grew weary of His ways
He drifted far from His call

cards.text: With Levi, true instruction was in his mouth, and nothing false was on his lips. Not ONE "Oh, what a nuisance!" out of him.

cards.question: Levi turned only a few people from iniquity.

cards.text: Then the LORD says a priest's lips should preserve knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth. A priest is supposed to be the friend you call with real questions, not the group chat that leaves you on read.

cards.question: Why should people seek instruction from a priest's mouth?

answers.text: He is the messenger of the LORD of Hosts
He is the guardian of the house of the LORD
He is the firstborn of the tribe of Levi

cards.text: And then the turn: these priests have departed from the way. That's the friend who ignores the GPS for twenty minutes because he KNOWS a shortcut.

cards.question: The LORD says these priests' instruction has caused many to ___.
The LORD says these priests have kept the covenant of Levi.

cards.text: So the LORD says He in turn has made them despised and humiliated before all the people. The priests who despised His name are now despised themselves.

cards.question: The LORD says these priests haven't kept His ways. What have they shown in matters of the law?
